event_name: Cornwell Quality Tools NHRA U.S. Nationals

pairs.note:
Weather conditions: air temperature 72 degrees, relative humidity 69 percent, barometer 30.11 inches,
adjusted altitude 2,243 feet, track temperature 89 degrees.

Eric Latino lost to Stanfield in Rd. 1 in Brainerd this year. This is the 1st time Greg Stanfield has
been in the bottom half of the field this year.

Latino goes red to give Stanfield the win.  Stanfield with his quickest pass of the weekend.

Eric Latino lost to Stanfield in Rd. 1 in Brainerd this year. This is the 1st time Greg Stanfield has
been in the bottom half of the field this year.

This is the first time Latino and Coughlin Jr. have faced each other in eliminations. 

Latino with a great light and th power to holed on for the hole shot win.  He makes the second
quickest pass of the event for the win.

Coughlin Jr. make the quickest pass of the event in the losing effort.

Erica Enders wins 85% of her Rd. 1 races when she has lane choice. Jerry Tucker is 12 - 26 in Rd. 1.

Enders is 3 - 1 against Tucker in prior events. 

Enders with a great light for the win.  She makes her quickest pass of the weekend for the win.

Tucker with his quickest pass of the weekend in the losing effort.

This is Chris Vang's 12th race. This is Jeg Coughlin's 510th race. His 744 round wins are 3rd most in
PS.

Vang is 1 - 0 against Coughlin in prior events. 

Coughlin with the starting line advantage and the power to hold on for the hole shot win in a close
one.  Jeg Coughlin's MOV: 0.0036 seconds (approximately 13 inches).   coughlin with his quickest pass
of the weekend for the win.

Matt Hartford is #1 & the #1 PS qualifier is 53 - 3 in Rd. 1 at this event.  Kenny Delco's 1st race
here was 1986 when the #1 PS driver qualified with a 7.377.

Hartford is 6 - 1 against Delco in prior events.

Delco rolls the beams and clicks it off.  Hartford launched hard and kept it hooked up to tie
Coughlin Jr.'s low E.T. of the event.  He will have lane choice over Greg Stanfield in the next
round.

In 81 meetings between Anderson's and Stanfield's the Anderson lead 43 - 38.  Aaron Stanfield has won
this race in 3 classes (PS, Factory Stock and Factory X). 

Stanfield is 2 - 0 against Anderson in prior events. 

Stanfield with the starting line advantage, but Anderson chased him down just past half track and
took the win.  Cody Anderson's MOV: 0.0071 seconds (approximately 2 feet).  Anderson with his
quickest pass of the weekend.  He will have lane choice over enders in the next round.

Stanfield with his quickest pass of weekend in the losing effort.

Dallas Glenn is 15 - 0 in Rd. 1 when qualified #2. Mason McGaha set Top Speed in Brainerd, the 1st
time he set Top Speed since St. Louis, 2021.

Glenn is 12 - 2 against McGaha in prior events. 

Glenn with the starting line advantage and never trailed for the win.  Glenn with his quickest pass
of the weekend for the win  He ties Matt Latino's E.T., but will give up lane choice based on his
slower speed.

McGaha with his quickest pass of the weekend in the losing effort.

This is the 15th year that Greg Anderson has won 4 or more races. Greg Anderson is 34 - 7 in Rd. 1
when qualified #5.  Shane Tucker's only race against Anderson was at Richmond in 2019.

Anderson is 1 - 0 against Tucker in prior events. 

Tucker with the starting line advantage, but Anderson has the difference made up by 330 feet and
holds on for the win in a close one.  Greg Anderson's MOV: 0.0043 seconds (approximately 16 inches).
Anderson with his quickest pass of the weekend for the win and lane choice over Jeg Coughlin in the
next round.

Tucker with his quickest pass of the weekend in the losing effort.
